risks.title: Dependence on weak organic growth and 2025 decline
risks.score_rationale: Present in financial data (Item 1A equivalent). Moderate language but eloquent data: growth -1.3% in 2025 after +14.1% in 2024, then +2.9% and +2.6% forecast. Downward trend confirmed. High category weight for IT distributor.

risks.title: Excessive geographic concentration on German market
risks.score_rationale: Clear data: 63.7% of domestic sales (Germany) in 2025, stable at 65.3% in forecasts. Position in Item 1A equivalent (regional data). Moderate intensity but high systemic risk. Trend stable but structurally concentrated.

risks.title: EBITDA margin erosion and operating profitability decline
risks.score_rationale: Explicit financial data: EBITDA margin 7.6% (2023) → 6.0% (2025) → 6.4% (2026E). EBIT margin 3.7% → 2.2% → 3.4%. Implicit language in ratios. Downward trend 2023-2025, slight recovery forecast. Critical category weight for distributor.

risks.title: Increased capital intensity and weak capital returns
risks.score_rationale: Balance sheet and cash-flow data: CAPEX forecast 39-37 EURm (2026-2028) versus 15-22 EURm (2023-2025). ROCE 4.7% (2025) versus implicit WACC ~7-8%. ROE 5.0% (2025). Implicit language. Downward trend. Medium-high category weight.

risks.title: Capital structure deterioration and rising net debt
risks.score_rationale: Balance sheet data: equity ratio 47% (2023) → 38% (2025) → 39% (2026E). Net debt/EBITDA -0.2x → 0.2x → 0.2x. Implicit language in ratios. Downward equity trend. Medium category weight for distributor.

risks.title: Dependence on acquisitions for growth and complex integration
risks.score_rationale: Cash-flow data: acquisitions 70 EURm (2023), 29 EURm (2024), 4 EURm (2025). Goodwill stable 270 EURm (19% of assets). Implicit language. Downward acquisitions trend. Medium category weight for consolidating distributor.

risks.title: Cash-flow volatility and fragile dividend coverage
risks.score_rationale: Cash-flow data: FCF 69 EURm (2023) → 125 EURm (2025) → 27 EURm (2026E). Dividend stable 32-35 EURm/year. FCF yield 9.7% → 17.6% → 7.4%. Implicit language. Downward trend 2025-2026. Medium category weight.

risks.title: Intense IT distribution competition and pricing pressure
risks.score_rationale: Implicit in peer group analysis (Bechtle AG, other comps) and margin data. Moderate language but clear context: CANCOM less profitable than peer group. Stable trend but structural. Very high category weight for distributor.

ai_positioning.summary: CANCOM makes no mention of significant AI initiatives or integration in its services or commercial offering. No indicator of AI adoption or development of AI solutions is presented.
